{{CSGO}}: 2018-10-08 }} '''Team Vitality''' is a [[:Category:France|French]] professional esports organization which entered ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' in early October 2018. They are commonly regarded as one of the most successful organizations in ''CS'' history, having won over 20 S-tier trophies, including three [[Majors]], and being the only organization to win two consecutive [[ESL/Grand Slam|ESL Grand Slams]]. Vitality is best known for its French-turned-international lineup, which has notably featured Mathieu "[[ZywOo]]" Herbaut and long-time in-game leader Dan "[[apEX]]" Madesclaire. ==Timeline== {{Tabs dynamic |name1=2018 |name2=2019 |name3=2020 |name4=2021 |name5=2022 |name6=2023 |name7=2024 |name8=2025 |name9=2026 |This=9 |content1= *October 8th -
